title: Text: DET R.J. Burgess ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Did you see that Orlando kid pitch last night?
I wasn’t there last night but I’ve seen him pitch. Matt Allan at Seminole HS. He’s good
I guess Anthopolous and Klentak were there but they won’t get him
Oh I see what you meant

I don’t know that I agree with that. HS right handers are tough man. So many flame out. I could see him getting to 10-15 depending on how year plays out. But there have definitely been games where he’s looked like an easy top 10 pick this year
You guys need to take Meisner
I said he looks like the mannequin at a dicks sporting goods with the under armor shirt on it
It’s definitely better than a physical description of “looks like me” He’s a beast. Chiseled jaw left handed hitting athletic beast
Guy I saw today said one time he saw him reminded him of josh Hamilton

Shit that’s high freaking praise I don’t know if I really have a comp but I know I like him. He’s not really even super “famous” yet because he was hurt last season and didn’t play last summer. Hopefully it stays that way...
But when you see him I don’t know how you don’t think he’s a top 5 pick.
